worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.summary: Sweeps its whole arm over its head and drops the upper body's weight onto one target: the blow knocks the target back and cracks the ground where the fist lands, while the momentum leaves the user staggering with Speed down 1 stage. The follow-through form throws and cracks farther at the cost of a lighter hit and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.use.0: Trade a heavy overhead blow for one hard target
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.use.1: Knock a target out of position and into a teammate's reach
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.use.2: Crack the ground where the fist lands and leave a short-lived scar
One overhead blow on a single foe deals about %1$s physical damage; reach %2$s blocks.
On a hit the target is pushed about %1$s blocks along the swing and the user's Speed drops %2$s stage(s); a miss does neither.
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.followthroug: Follow-through form: knock-back x1.35, cleft radius %1$s blocks and %2$s cracks, driving the target out of position; costs power x0.9 and a slower wind-up and recovery.
Held-breath form: the force is checked before contact, so the single hit is heavier and faster, but throws and cracks less.
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.growth.0: From level %1$s the blow power rises to %2$s and the knock-back to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.growth.1: From level %1$s the blow power rises to %2$s and the number of cracks to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.preference.f: On: knock-back x1.35 and a larger, denser cleft that drives the target out of position; costs power x0.9, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +3 ticks, cooldown +6 ticks. Off (held-breath): the force is checked before contact, so the single hit is heavier and faster, but throws and cracks less.
worldcombat.skill.hammerarm.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the blow from farther, but it is easier to sidestep during the wind-up.
On: low-health targets rank higher so one heavy boot finishes them; off: all targets score the same.
A landed blow cracks the surface dirt, stone or sand near the fist's landing point: within a radius of %1$s blocks, up to %2$s blocks; the cracks return to normal after about 5 seconds.
